## Runbook
[Open investigation runbook](https://app.datadoghq.com/notebook/14477914)

## Dashboard
[Open Host Disk dashboard](https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/$DASHBOARD_ID)

Quick triage from your laptop:
```
cd deploy/vm/ansible
ansible {{host.name}} -i inventory.ini -b -m ansible.builtin.shell \
  -a "du -h -d 1 -x / 2>/dev/null | sort -hr | head -10 && docker system df"
```

Most likely culprits: unrotated container logs, Docker build cache, or journald sprawl. See the runbook for fix commands.
